frontMatter.title: Thursday Club Night
frontMatter.summary: Thursday Club Night fixtures: Grade 2 Mixed (Navan “B” vs Athboy/Kells) and Grade 6 Mixed (Navan “B” vs Longwood). Members: 2 courts available from 9:30pm—get down early.

prev.title: Club Night – Wednesday at Navan Badminton Club
prev.summary: This Wednesday at Navan Badminton Club: Grade 4 Mixed (Navan B vs Mullingar A) and Grade 5 Men’s (Navan A vs Ardee A). Two courts available for members from 8:30pm; Juvenile Club from 6:30pm is league matches only.

next.title: Meath U17's Shine at Leinster Intercounty Finals
next.summary: Meath won Division 1 silver with the Meath U17 A team, and bronze with the Meath U17 B at the Leinster U17 Intercounty Finals in Baldoyle.
